To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Niagara University college teachers: (1) believe teaching is a complex and challenging activity; (2) believe that the best teachers have a strong commitment to student learning, are passionate about their subject, and are dedicated to helping students learn; (3) believe that teaching is a craft that requires a great deal of preparation; (4) believe that the most effective teachers are those who are willing to take risks, are open to new ideas and are always learning themselves; and, (5) believe that
the great college teachers we read about are “committed, reflective, and skilled” in their teaching.

Niagara University college teachers believe: • Students learn more effectively when they are actively engaged in their own learning, • Students learn more when they have the opportunity to apply what they learn in a meaningful way, and • Students learn more deeply when they can connect what they are learning to their own lives, to the lives of others, and to the world beyond the classroom.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: 1) What do college teachers think about teaching and learning?
what Niagara University College Teachers think.
the question: what can Niagara University College Teachers learn from the best college teachers about how to think about teaching?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
great teachers are those that understand and apply a variety of teaching strategies to help students learn.

the best college teachers do the following: They know their subjects and how to teach them; They care deeply about their subjects; They are good at presenting their subjects; They involve their students actively in their subject; They care about and help their students learn; They care about their students; and They continue to learn to teach better.

the best teachers are those who have a deep understanding of their discipline, who are committed to their students and who know how to create a learning environment that is conducive to student learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are a community of teachers who want to improve our teaching, and we want to do so by learning from the best.
the great college teachers are not necessarily the most charismatic or entertaining.
the great college teachers do their work with a strong focus on students, and that they have a deep sense of what it means to teach and learn well.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the best college teachers do not have one single, simple, easy to implement strategy that they apply consistently.
the best teachers are not necessarily the best scholars, and the most popular teachers are not necessarily among the best.
we are all in this together and we need to support each other in our teaching and learning.
